content.title: Alec Baldwin plans retirement after ‘Rust’ tragedy, says ' Don't want to leave my house anymore, want to stay with my kids'
content.text: Playing Picture-in-pictureNewsentertainmentenglishhollywoodAlec Baldwin plans retirement after ‘Rust’ tragedy, says ' Don't want to leave my house anymore, want to stay with my kids'CommentsAAText SizeSmallMediumLargeHollywood star Alec Baldwin, shaken by the tragic 'Rust' set incident, now prioritizes family over career. He revealed a desire to retire and stay home with his seven children, finding solace in his wife Hilaria's support. Despite legal battles surrounding cinematographer Halyna Hutchins' death, Baldwin expressed relief at the case's dismissal, emphasizing his family as his anchor.Alec Baldwin, one of Hollywood's most recognisable faces, best known for his roles in '30 Rock' and 'The Hunt for Red October', recently said that his priorities have shifted dramatically in recent years. The Oscar-nominated actor speaks about his desire to step away from the industry entirely, and the reason is deeply personal. The actor opened up about how the 2021 tragedy on the set of 'Rust', which claimed the life of cinematographer Halyna Hutchins, changed the course of his life.Alec Baldwin plans to retireReflecting on the 'Rust' tragedy, Baldwin told The Hollywood Reporter, "That was unspeakably difficult to deal with. Because of the situation, I wound up staying home a lot. I was home with my kids for three-and-a-half years. I hardly worked at all, and that's just changing now. I'm going to go off and do a bunch of things. But I was home, and I got used to it, and I don't want to leave my house anymore. I don't want to work anymore. I want to retire and stay home with my kids."The experience of reconnecting with his children during those years has profoundly shifted his perspective towards life, moving him away from the relentless pace of Hollywood's demands. Watch Alec Baldwin’s ‘Apology’ Turns Viral: Fans Slam Actor After Hamptons Car Crash ‘Rust’: The fallout and legal battleAccording to Entertainment Weekly, Hutchins lost her life as a result of Baldwin discharging a prop gun with live rounds on set. In January 2023, he was charged with involuntary manslaughter. The charges were dropped months later, but he was charged again in January 2024, before a judge officially dismissed the case with prejudice in July 2024, meaning it cannot be refiled. 'Rust' armorer Hannah Gutierrez-Reed was convicted of involuntary manslaughter and served 13 months in prison.Alec Baldwin declared to THR, "They tried to get me, and they didn't get me, and they cheated and broke the law to get me, and it's just been tough."Alec Baldwin describes family as his anchorBaldwin shares seven children with his wife, Hilaria, and the family offered an inside look at their life during the 2025 reality series 'The Baldwins'. Of Hilaria, Baldwin said, "If it weren't for you, I wouldn't have survived all of the Rust situation, so thank you."Through this period of uncertainty and pain, his family became his sanctuary, helping him rebuild his sense of purpose beyond the spotlight.'Rust' was eventually completed and released in 2025. With Baldwin's cooperation, director Rory Kennedy also recently premiered the documentary 'The Trial of Alec Baldwin'.End of ArticleFollow Us On Social Media'It's your show. It's your creative vision' - James Cameron teams up with Billie Eilish for 3D concert filmANI / Apr 14, 2026, 10:11 ISTCommentsAAText SizeSmallMediumLargeJames Cameron teams up with Billie Eilish for 3D concert film, says new tour movie will "blow people's minds"Singer-songwriter Billie Eilish has teamed up with acclaimed filmmaker James Cameron for a new 3D concert film titled 'Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour' (Live in 3D), which is set to release on May 8, according to People. The newly released trailer offers a behind-the-scenes look at Eilish's sold-out world tour and her collaboration with Cameron, who serves as co-director on the project."It's your show. It's your creative vision. This is going to blow people's minds," Cameron says in the opening of the trailer. The trailer shows the duo working closely together, including scenes of them wearing 3D glasses and discussing creative decisions for the film. In one moment, Eilish asks, "So how does that even work, just out of curiosity?" to which Cameron responds, "We're going to have to play some games, but we'll make it look great," according to People.The film aims to take audiences beyond the stage, offering immersive access to Eilish's performances and behind-the-scenes moments from her global tour. It also highlights her close connection with fans, whom she refers to as "friends.""The day of a show, for me, just feels like any day at all. I just feel like I'm going to hang out with my friends," Eilish says in the trailer, adding, "I want to feel like it's me and them.""You love them?" Cameron asks later in the trailer, to which Eilish replies, "I love them."The "Birds of a Feather" singer later declares, "I want to be the artist that I would want to be a fan of," according to People.The singer also reveals a personal tour tradition of maintaining a "puppy room" at each venue, allowing her crew to spend time with rescue dogs amid the demands of touring. Cameron is seen engaging with the idea, saying, "I'm doing this on my next movie for sure," according to People. Watch James Cameron To Adapt 'Ghosts Of Hiroshima' As Next Big Non-Avatar Project Describing the project, the official synopsis states that the film brings an "innovative new concert experience to the big screen from one of the most celebrated and successful artists of her generation," according to People.Eilish later shared the trailer on Instagram, writing, "It's almost HEREEEEE," building anticipation among fans worldwide, according to People.End of ArticleFollow Us On Social MediaPriyanka Chopra reacts with love to John Cena’s tribute to Asha Bhosle; calls the late icon ‘Queen’CommentsAAText SizeSmallMediumLargeThe musical icon and legendary playback singer Asha Bhosle passed away at the age of 92. Her last rites were performed with state honours on Monday at Shivaji Park, Mumbai. Celebrities from across the globe have been paying tribute to her through social media. John Cena, a former WWE star and now a Hollywood actor, also took to his social media handle to pay final respects. His tribute touched hearts and earned praise from netizens. Hollywood and Bollywood icon Priyanka Chopra also commented on John Cena’s post dedicated to Asha Bhosle.Priyanka Chopra reacts to John Cena’s tribute to Asha BhosleJohn Cena didn’t use any caption; perhaps he was so overwhelmed after hearing the news that he felt words wouldn’t do justice. He simply shared a very beautiful picture of the late artist Asha Bhosle singing at an event. In the pictures, she was seen dressed in a surreal white saree, with her iconic gajra in her hair, a red bindi on her forehead, and a million-dollar smile. Watch John Cena’s tribute to Asha Bhosle goes viral as fans call it legendary respect 05:13 The post went viral in no time, attracting comments left and right. Priyanka Chopra also reacted to the post. She posted a fire and heart emoticon, followed by the term ‘Queen’ to describe the late legendary singer. Netizens laud John Cena for his gestureAsha Bhosle took Indian music to a global scale. Her fame was not restricted to any boundaries, and John Cena’s post is proof of the same. Yet the internet was happily shocked to see John’s tribute. “Thank you @johncena for acknowledging this legend,” wrote a netizen. “It feels great when a legend notices another legend,” commented another. “This is the reason why we call him a 🐐 goat,” penned another internet user, appreciating John Cena’s tribute post for Asha Bhosle.Asha Bhosle Death: Late Asha Bhosle's granddaughter Zanai Bhosle expresses gratitude for honoring her grandmother: 'She's seen it all from above'John’s post is yet another proof of how Asha Bhosle, through her craft, touched millions of hearts and lives across the globe.Priyanka Chopra's heartfelt post in the loving memory of Asha BhoslePriyanka Chopra also took to her social media handle to share a heart-melting tribute for the legendary vocalist Asha Bhosle. Posting a picture with the iconic star, followed by a video of Asha Bhosle singing one of her most beloved 'Umrao Jaan' songs, she wrote, "There are some losses that feel like losing a piece of your childhood, your memories, your home. Asha ji was that for so many of us. Her voice wasn’t just part of Indian music, it was part of the backdrop of our lives. It played through our homes growing up, through family celebrations, through heartbreaks, through joy, through the quiet and loud moments that became memories before we realized it.""For my generation and so many before and after, she wasn’t simply a legend we admired, she was a constant. A voice so eternal it felt like it would always be there. It is hard to put into words what it means to lose someone whose art helped shape the emotional landscape of an entire nation. Thank you, Asha ji, for giving us a lifetime of songs, of feeling, of beauty," she concluded.End of ArticleFollow Us On Social MediaMike Colter SPOILS Charlie Cox's 'Daredevil: Born Again' season 2 ending; reveals possible connection to Tom Holland's 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day'CommentsAAText SizeSmallMediumLarge'The Defenders' star Mike Colter sent Marvel fans into a meltdown after he seemingly dropped a major spoiler about the series 'Daredevil: Born Again' Season 2. The actor, who plays Luke Cage in a now deleted social media post, shared a photo with leading man Charlie Cox as Matt Murdock. However, the post seemed to reveal a major detail about the ending of the critically acclaimed series. SPOLIERS AHEADColter briefly shared an apparent spoiler suggesting that Matt Murdock, also known as Daredevil, will be arrested and thrown into prison. Charlie was seen posing for the pic in an orange prison uniform. The development has led fans to theorise a possible adaptation of the “Devil in Cell Block D” storyline, where the character is incarcerated before orchestrating a dramatic escape.Fans react to Mike's postDaredevil and Spider-Man to team up againThe speculation has further fuelled rumours of a crossover with 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day', particularly after fans pointed out a link between the series and a moment in the film’s trailer. In one sequence, Spider-Man is shown battling the Hand, a long-time adversary of Daredevil. This fight scene takes place in a prison, further fuelling speculation that Spider-Man could aid in Daredevil's escape. Fans have also long suspected the two superheroes teaming up in the film that also features Mark Ruffalo as the Hulk and Jon Bernthal as The Punisher. Charlie Cox denies 'Spider-Man' castingHowever, Charlie previously denied any involvement in the upcoming 'Spider-Man' film. Speaking on Jimmy Kimmel Live!, he addressed the rumours, stating, “I know they all think I’m in Spider-Man because I’m filming something in London. Which I’m not — I’m not in Spider-Man.”Despite his denial, fan speculation remains high, particularly given Marvel’s history of keeping cameo appearances under wraps. Cox previously appeared as Murdock alongside Tom Holland in 'Spider-Man: No Way Home', where he played Peter Parker’s lawyer.'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' cast and release dateThe upcoming film is already generating buzz for its ensemble cast, which includes Zendaya, Jacob Batalon, and Sadie Sink.'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' is slated for release on July 31, 2026.End of ArticleFollow Us On Social Media
